shared_elements: carved stone surface with shallow incised/low-relief lines
human figure with elaborate headdress or head covering
patterned garment or textile rendered as parallel lines and bands
justification: Both are stone monuments carved in shallow relief showing an adorned human figure with linear garment bands and roundel/disc elements, and both are photographed in a gallery setting. But A is a wide horizontal panel with two figures in fine, crisp profile facing each other in a narrative exchange, whereas B is a single blocky, heavily eroded frontal figure on a vertical monolith with coarse, summary carving — so the compositional scheme and carving manner differ fundamentally.
